messages.campaign_fixture.quest.locations.title: Campaign fixture: shared destinations
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.locations.descrip: Visit the village bound to this campaign. Another player will receive the same destination.
campaign_fixture.quest.locations.offer.l: This test selects a known village within 256 blocks of the world spawn. That village stays the destination for every player.
campaign_fixture.quest.locations.reminde: Reach the village marked by this quest. Exploring a closer village will not change the destination.
You reached the saved destination. Reload the world or try with another player to check that it stays the same.
